parallelism.wave_semantics: Earliest eligibility under conservative active conditional branches; not calendar time or a global barrier.

conditional_policy: Unknown means HOLD for affected nodes/edges. NOT_APPLICABLE requires an explicit MVP-003/MVP-004 scope decision; it is never inferred from elapsed time.
dispatch_rule: Dependencies integrated/accepted, activation known, external gates satisfied, idle worker and write leases available. Acquire verification resource only when entering that phase; consumers start from the integrated dependency SHA.

lock_descriptions.ENVIRONMENT: Pinned toolchain setup and dependency repair
lock_descriptions.DOCS: Cross-project requirement reconciliation; generated doc artifacts handled by integrator
lock_descriptions.CORE_STATE: src-tauri/src/runtime.rs shared lifecycle/state and announcer.rs epoch-scoped detector state
lock_descriptions.UTTERANCE: src-tauri/src/utterance.rs session identity/epoch envelope and stale-event gate
lock_descriptions.UI_ONBOARDING: Local setup/readiness UI; account sign-in is optional and Closed Beta gating is cancelled
lock_descriptions.UI_SETTINGS: app/Control and settings lifecycle/session-scoped advice state
lock_descriptions.PACKAGING: Tauri resources, native dependencies and lockfiles

verification_resources.LOCAL_VALIDATION_HOST: Exclusive local runtime/build/Dota/GPU/audio/traffic validation slot. No other local builds, Ollama, STT, capture or heavy checks during timed/FPS measurements.
verification_resources.HOSTED_CI_RUNNER: Independent hosted runner; may run concurrently with local validation if it does not execute on that same host.

critical_path_note: Longest chain by edge count only; not a duration estimate. File/resource queues and owner decisions can dominate elapsed time.
activation_constraints: account_gate_required === true implies account_surface_exposed === true and legacy_handoff_surface_in_scope === true
An inactive node satisfies applicable joins only with an explicit NOT_APPLICABLE scope record.

post_dag_actions.release: Requires a separate explicit release request and applicable workflow/owner approvals. No dispatch/release action is performed by this planning artifact.

phase_lock_policy.work: Hold write leases through integration acceptance; acquire LOCAL_VALIDATION_HOST only during runtime/build checks.
phase_lock_policy.verification: Acquire verification resources before running; final local measurements are mutually exclusive.
phase_lock_policy.decision: Owner decision is external; drafting is not approval and a waiting decision need not occupy a worker.
phase_lock_policy.scope_change: Re-evaluate actual file overlap and regenerate batches when write scope changes.

execution_run.authorization: Owner requested GPT-6 Luna max parallel work and instructed to continue.
execution_run.completion_policy: PREPARED, INTEGRATED, VERIFIED, RUNNING, and DECISION_PENDING do not satisfy DONE dependencies.

scope_change_records.authority: Owner explicitly approved the write-lock extension in W04 coordination.
scope_change_records.reason: Session epochs tag and reject stale capture-derived, utterance, overlay callback state, and Control advice requests/results; CORE_STATE now also resets process-global announcer streak/dedup state only when the session epoch changes.
scope_change_records.overlap_review: MVP-028 was merged before MVP-015 expanded into UI_SETTINGS; no concurrent writer remains. Later settings work uses its existing UI_SETTINGS lease, and CAPTURE/AUDIO work depends on MVP-015 or starts afterward. Announcer state is held under the already exclusive CORE_STATE lease.

decision_record.authority: Owner explicitly delegated decisions to Codex: ตัดสินใจเลย (2026-10-10)
